event_team_size_check.name: event_team_size_check
event_team_size_check.value: ("event"."team_min_size" is null and "event"."team_max_size" is null) or ("event"."team_min_size" >= 1 and "event"."team_max_size" >= "event"."team_min_size")

member_grade_snapshot_check.name: member_grade_snapshot_check
member_grade_snapshot_check.value: "member_grade"."status" in ('draft', 'submitted') or ("member_grade"."presence_points" is not null and "member_grade"."final_score" is not null)

tournament_match_pool_check.name: tournament_match_pool_check
tournament_match_pool_check.value: ("tournament_match"."phase" = 'pool') = ("tournament_match"."pool" is not null) and ("tournament_match"."draw" = false or "tournament_match"."phase" = 'pool')

tournament_match_scores_check.name: tournament_match_scores_check
tournament_match_scores_check.value: ("tournament_match"."score_a" is null) = ("tournament_match"."score_b" is null) and coalesce("tournament_match"."score_a", 0) >= 0 and coalesce("tournament_match"."score_b", 0) >= 0

treasury_transaction_kind_sign_check.name: treasury_transaction_kind_sign_check
treasury_transaction_kind_sign_check.value:
"treasury_transaction"."reversal_of_id" is not null or "treasury_transaction"."kind" = 'other'
        or ("treasury_transaction"."kind" = 'debit' and "treasury_transaction"."amount_cents" < 0)
        or ("treasury_transaction"."kind" = 'credit' and "treasury_transaction"."amount_cents" > 0)
